messages:
deploy-bot: kickstarting release wave: api@v2.3.2, runtime@v4.7-rc2, console@v1.9.1, router@v3.0.2. Change window 2025-06-20 22:00->2025-06-21 02:00 UTC. Initial canary: 2% (us-west1). Pins: runtime -> 4.7-rc2, router -> 3.0.2-canary. Rollback triggers set (see below). Ack and surface any cross-service gotchas.
maria: ack. main concern: runtime rc2 changed kv eviction policy in some RNG paths. need to ensure we don't evict active prefix keys used by api rerank flow.
jess: api: no backward-incompatible schema. rerank relies on stable prefix caching. if TTL shortened we could see QPS/latency flash.
kyle: runtime: spotted the eviction tweak in rc2. default KV_TTL is 12s (down from 30s). we baked it for mem pressure but agree it's risky for canary. we can pass helm value: --set kv.ttl=30s to the canary helm release. happy to set it.
sam: console: panels will surface cache-miss spikes if TTL low. plan to mute auto-refresh for 20m during canary and add a label on dashboards with this release ID.
oncall-sre: adding the usual pager thresholds but proposing a slightly tighter threshold for this wave: auto-cut if errors >0.75% sustained 4m OR p95>450ms sustained 3m. first failure -> cut to 0% then manual review. I'll wire the slack alert and runbook.
aaron: ops note: router header-swap mapping changed in 3.0.2-canary. api teams, double-check header routing keys — misroutes could fake latency spikes.
maria: request: can we get SHAs in the deploy-bot post and exact helm/override commands so release notes include precise rollback steps?
deploy-bot: updated with SHAs: api@v2.3.2 -> sha: d4e5f6a, runtime@v4.7-rc2 -> sha: b7c8d9e, console@v1.9.1 -> sha: 9a8b7c6, router@v3.0.2 -> sha: e1f2g3h. Also publishing helm overrides for canary below.
kyle: pushed helm override to chart values for runtime-canary: `kv:
  ttl: "30s"
  max_entries: 20000`
sam: console will apply `dashboard.refresh.enabled=false` to dashboards tagged `release/1762223333` for first 20m.
jess: prepping smoke set now: short-run cases for prefix cache, long-run sequences, and router header routing. will run 200 reqs at 2rps across 8 seeds. posting command:
```
./smoke.sh --target api.internal --cases prefix,longseq,rerank --concurrency 2 --total 200
```
oncall-sre: monitoring hooks: prometheus -> alertmanager rule created. On alert the bot will execute an automated traffic cut to fallback and post to #incidents. Rule summary: errors>0.75% for 4m OR p95>450ms for 3m => auto-cut.
maria: release-note bullets to include: - runtime kv.ttl override for canary - router header-swap map update - pinned runtime/router versions - canary ramp plan and rollback playbook. I'll PR to release-notes repo.
aaron: verifying router header map: mapping for X-Route-Key changed to prefer header v2. if api sends old header we'll still route but at lower priority; recommend api add compatibility header during canary.
jess: we'll add compatibility header for 2h during canary. quick patch deployed to api-canary.
kyle: runtime logs show TTL applied: `2025-06-20T22:05:12Z INFO kv: ttl=30s entries=1200`. no OOMs so far.
oncall-sre: watching metrics. current canary (2%) live. I'll escalate if we hit thresholds. posting automated rollback snippet below for convenience:
```
# immediate traffic cut to fallback
kubectl -n routing exec deploy/router-controller -- /bin/sh -c "./routectl set-weight api-canary --traffic 0 && ./routectl set-weight api-stable --traffic 100"
# pin runtime back to last stable
kubectl -n runtime set image sts/runtime-prod runtime=runtime:4.6.8 --record
# revert router mapping
kubectl -n router patch configmap router-config -p '{"data":{"header_map":"stable"}}'
```
maria: good. timeline: stay at 2% for 15m if no alerts, then 10% for 30m, then 40% for 45m, then gradual to 100% after 2h if green. keep manual gates at each step. everyone ok?
sam: ok from console side, panels muted and tags applied. will resume refresh after the 15m steady window.
jess: smoke run started. posting summary in 10m. :eyes:
oncall-sre: noted. I'll be on watch for the first 30m and will execute auto-cut if needed.
maria: thanks all — i'll assemble the final rollout note and push. I'll close thread at 10% ramp or earlier on rollback.
